experience_1_description: Working on E-Book, an official-correspondence platform for a government organisation, built with Laravel, Go, PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Redis. I built ebook-auth, a standalone Go authentication service that issues RS256 JWTs with JWKS key rotation, refresh and revocation, and migrated the Laravel API onto it as the single password authority. I also designed and shipped Letter Operations: an append-only, database-enforced audit trail covering 20 letter operation types, restorable deletes, and history views scoped to each user's place in the organisational hierarchy. I grew auth test coverage from 3 to 26 tests using an HTTP-level fake of the auth service, so the suite runs without live dependencies in a third of the time.
